milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The smithing table is at spawn-relative position (7, 1, 5), placed 1 block inside the workshop entrance. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the building entrance or entered the workshop (not just happened to face the right direction from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the smithing table, demonstrating they have identified and located it among the distractor blocks (anvil, blast furnace, crafting table, barrel).
